messages:
Kevin L.: FYI found CVE-2026-12345 in our `kms-client` transitive dep. Affects token refresh flow. Exploitability: low->medium but public PoC circulating.
Maria K.: thanks. do we have customers on Dedicated/private using older pinned versions?
Kevin L.: yes — a few on Dedicated (eu-west) and one on Private (on-prem, finance). No known exploit in prod yet.
Alex P.: what's the SLA impact if we take a hotfix deploy? Rolling patch will cause ~2-3 min of connection restarts per pod, small latency blip.
Jess S.: support: we should notify enterprise account teams and SOC contacts — finance customer is on tier-1.
Maria K.: propose: schedule immediate canary in staging -> eu-west canary -> global rollout with canary gates. Notify customers in parallel for tier-1 and tier-2.
Kevin L.: agree. timeline: canary tonight 23:30 UTC, full rollout 02:00 if no regression. Is midnight deploy allowed for Dedicated per contract?
Alex P.: Dedicated SLA allows maintenance windows but not unannounced outages. We'll use canary + auto-rollback. create an incident ticket and set maintenance for affected tenants.
ops-sre: deploy-bot: Started canary deploy of `kms-client@1.2.3-hotfix` to cluster:eu-west. Track: https://deploys/in/789
Kevin L.: tagged release with `cherry-pick:security` and added audit log delta (we'll log key rotations).
Maria K.: add audit-log event for `kms.token.refresh` and KMS call latencies, retention 180d for affected orgs.
Jess S.: prepping customer notices: pls add list of exposed orgs (kevin). I'll draft msg for tier-1 now.
Kevin L.: added list to ticket INC-2026-876 and pinned to thread.
Alex P.: if canary fails we rollback and schedule a code freeze window to investigate; if success we'll do staggered 3-region rollout with 15m intervals and monitor error budget.
Maria K.: approved. action items: 1) patch PR merged (alex), 2) canary tonight (sre), 3) customer notif (jess), 4) audit logging + retention (kevin).
Jess S.: :thumbsup: I'll send notice to tier-1 in next 30m.
Kevin L.: thanks all. follow-ups in INC-2026-876.
